messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Yan mata na kwace mana mazajenmu da shigar banza – Matan aure sun yi zanga-zanga

output.joy: Matan aure sun jaddada karfin su tare da zanga-zanga akan yadda suka kwace mana mazajenmu na shigar banza!
output.sadness: Abin takaici ne cewa yan mata sun kwace mana mazajenmu da shigar banza, Matan aure sun yi zanga-zanga don jawo hankali.
output.fear: Matan aure sun yi zanga-zanga da fargaba akan yadda yan mata ke kwace mana mazajenmu da shigar banza!
output.anger: Wannan abin ban haushi ne! Matan aure sun yi zanga-zanga saboda yan mata sun kwace mana mazajenmu da shigar banza!
output.surprise: Wannan abin ba a zata ba! Matan aure sun yi zanga-zanga kan yadda yan mata suka kwace mana mazajenmu da shigar banza!
output.disgust: Wannan yanayi yana da guba; Matan aure sun yi zanga-zanga a kan yadda yan mata suka kwace mana mazajenmu da shigar banza!
